author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
Join me on a sometimes quite scenic commute from Puerto de Mazarrón and Cartagena (and back via a different route) in Murcia, Southeastern Spain.  This video was assembled from clips recorded of the same journey on different days (my camera overheated when I tried to record it all in one) - so you'll see the sky and other things change at various points. 

The native recorded audio would have just been the noise of the cabin air conditioning and conversation of the passengers, so instead I have added some ambient music, which is the following tracks, all by Jesse Gallagher from the YouTube Audio Library:-
Venkatesananda
Mer-Ka-Ba
Maestro Tlakaelel
The Inner Sound
Satya Yuga
Spirit of Fire
Monumental Journey

Slow TV is not for everyone - nothing much happens on purpose and there is no narration or action, but people who like it, really seem to love it. there are no unexpected loud noises in this video and no midroll ads.
